title: Zbot hook stdout response v1
$comment: Exit zero + empty stdout also means continue. Otherwise stdout contains exactly one object <=32 KiB UTF-8. Runtime permits block only on session_start,user_prompt,run_start,before_model,before_tool,invalid_tool_call; context only on session_start,user_prompt,run_start,before_model. Accumulated context is <=8 KiB UTF-8 per invocation, supplied as attributed data via existing context assembly, never system instructions or persisted memory. reason is not projected into Activity; fixed server labels are used. Illegal action/context is invocation failure under on_failure.
